name: codex_test
description: Task Script Board is a script-first planner with live code, graph, and kanban views, collaborative spaces/folders, role-based user management, Jira/profile settings, slug rename tools, and persistent sessions.

scripts.build:dist: npm run build:dist:clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-dist.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:chrome-connect
scripts.test:coverage:all: npm run test:unit:coverage && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:chrome-connect
scripts.test:unit: node --loader tsx --test tests/task.unit.test.js tests/kanban.unit.test.js tests/formatter.unit.test.js tests/canvas.unit.test.js tests/app.contract.unit.test.js tests/editor.contract.unit.test.js tests/styles.contract.unit.test.js
scripts.test:unit:coverage: sh -c 'if command -v c8 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec c8 node --loader tsx --test tests/task.unit.test.js tests/kanban.unit.test.js tests/formatter.unit.test.js tests/canvas.unit.test.js tests/app.contract.unit.test.js tests/editor.contract.unit.test.js tests/styles.contract.unit.test.js; fi; echo "c8 not found; running unit tests without coverage" >&2; exec node --loader tsx --test tests/task.unit.test.js tests/kanban.unit.test.js tests/formatter.unit.test.js tests/canvas.unit.test.js tests/app.contract.unit.test.js tests/editor.contract.unit.test.js tests/styles.contract.unit.test.js'
